description_html:

In this role, you will drive smarter, data-driven decisions and identify opportunities that promote growth and efficiency.   • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and security of data in compliance with company policies and industry best practices.
  • Continuously support data-driven decision-making processes to enhance operational efficiency and strategic planning.
  • Stay updated with emerging data analytics technologies, tools, and best practices to maintain competitive edge.
  • Assist in troubleshooting data-related issues and optimize data collection and analysis workflows.

title: Business Analyst / Data Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst / Data Analyst to serve as a vital link between business and technical teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in requirements gathering, SQL, data analysis, data mapping, validation, reporting, and stakeholder management. This role demands a detail-oriented professional capable of translating complex business needs into clear technical specifications while ensuring data accuracy and quality throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Business & Requirement Analysis:
- Gather, analyze, and document business, functional, and data requirements.
- Facilitate requirement discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
- Translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Use Cases, and Acceptance Criteria.
- Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, and manage requirement changes effectively.

Data Analysis & Mapping:
- Analyze data from multiple source systems to detect trends, gaps, and inconsistencies.
- Develop and execute SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and reconciliation.
- Prepare source-to-target data mappings, transformation rules, and define business logic.
- Examine data flows, system integrations, and dependencies.
- Support logical and physical data modeling aligned with business requirements.

Data Quality & Reporting:
- Define and validate data quality and business validation rules.
- Perform source-to-target reconciliation and investigate discrepancies.
- Collect requirements for reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics.
- Collaborate with BI and data teams to ensure accurate implementation of reporting needs.
- Assist in validating Power BI and Tableau reports and dashboards.

UAT & Stakeholder Management:
- Prepare User Acceptance Testing (UAT) scenarios, test cases, and validation criteria.
- Validate data, reports, dashboards, and business rules during UAT.
- Coordinate with Developers, QA, Data Engineers, BI teams, and business users to resolve issues.
- Conduct requirement walkthroughs and communicate solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data Governance:
- Maintain data dictionaries, business definitions, metadata, naming conventions, and data lineage documentation.
- Support initiatives related to data quality, governance, traceability, and auditability.

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 6 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Business Data Analyst.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and data analysis techniques.
- Experience with data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation processes.
- Expertise in requirement gathering and documentation, including BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Use Cases, and UAT.
- Solid understanding of data models, data flows, databases, and reporting systems.
- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
- Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with Power BI and Tableau for reporting and dashboard development.
- Proficiency in Excel, Power Query, and basic DAX functions.
- Knowledge of Jira and Confluence tools.
- Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and Data Warehouse concepts.
- Basic understanding of API/integration mechanisms.
- Familiarity with Python and Pandas for data manipulation.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing the entire project lifecycle, from business requirement gathering through data analysis, mapping, validation, reporting, UAT, and final business sign-off.

Work Details

- Location: Hyderabad
- Work Mode: Hybrid, with three days per week onsite
- Working Hours: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM
- Role Type: Contract

title: Business Development Data Analyst (4362)
description_html:
The Business Development Data Analyst plays a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and reliability of business development data within internal systems. This position supports the Business Development (BD) team by entering and updating data in real time, identifying inconsistencies, and maintaining high-quality reporting and workflow continuity. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, responsible, and takes full ownership of their tasks while demonstrating a solid understanding of research operations and data entry standards. A strong ability to read and interpret clinical trial protocols, combined with critical thinking and problem-solving skills, is essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

- Enter and update data in Atom and Salesforce on the same day to maintain current tracking and reporting.
- Maintain a minimum of 90% data entry accuracy, ensuring high standards of data quality.
- Identify inconsistencies, gaps, and errors in data; correct them when possible or escalate to relevant teams for resolution.
- Review and interpret study documentation, including clinical trial protocols, as needed.
- Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to address data issues, workflow gaps, and reporting discrepancies.
- Monitor and uphold data integrity across large-scale databases and BD tracking systems.
- Support team and departmental productivity by performing additional duties as assigned.
- Ensure data entry is consistent, clear, and aligned with departmental standards and processes.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree.
- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
- Demonstrated understanding of clinical research and research-related data entry practices.
- High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong organizational and communication skills.
- Ability to interact professionally with a diverse range of individuals, including executives, managers, clinicians, and subject matter experts.
- Experience with managing large-scale databases and maintaining data integrity.
- Proficiency in computer software, including Excel (with Google scripts), Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and SQL Server queries.
- Ability to learn and navigate multiple, diverse data systems.

Preferred Qualifications and Additional Information

- At least one year of prior experience in clinical research is preferred.
- Current employees with knowledge of the company’s data systems are preferred.
- Ability to read and understand clinical trial protocols is preferred but can be trained.
- Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools is an advantage.
- Highly responsible with strong ownership and accountability for assigned work.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic team focused on accurate data management and business development support within the clinical research environment. The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-focused, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of data quality and operational efficiency.

title: SEO Analyst Intern ----- Kot Abdul Malik
description_html:
Rankdrill is seeking a motivated SEO Analyst Intern to join our team in Kot Abdul Malik. This entry-level position is ideal for fresh candidates interested in developing a career in search engine optimization and digital marketing. The intern will gain hands-on experience in keyword research, content analysis, backlink analysis, and SEO reporting, while supporting the team in executing various SEO campaigns. Candidates should have a basic understanding of SEO principles and digital marketing concepts, along with familiarity in using tools such as Google Analytics and Excel or Google Sheets. The role emphasizes learning, punctuality, communication, and the ability to follow instructions closely to deliver tasks on time. As an SEO Analyst Intern at Rankdrill, you will work under guidance, helping to collect and analyze data to optimize website content and improve search engine rankings. The role requires a proactive approach to learning new SEO techniques and staying updated with industry trends. Although this position does not involve managing a team, the intern will collaborate with other team members to support the companys SEO strategies. Strong attention to detail, good communication skills, and a positive attitude are essential to succeed and grow within the digital marketing domain.
Responsibilities
  • Conduct keyword research to identify relevant search terms and trends to improve website ranking.
  • Analyze website content and structure to optimize on-page SEO elements.
  • Assist in backlink analysis to evaluate the quality and relevance of incoming links.
  • Compile and prepare SEO reports using tools such as Google Analytics and SEO reporting platforms.
  • Use SEO tools to monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the SEO team by performing basic data entry and maintaining organized records in Google Sheets or MS Office.
  • Follow instructions precisely to complete assigned tasks within deadlines.
  • Stay informed about current SEO best practices and updates across search engines.
  • Communicate findings and learnings effectively with supervisors and team members.
  • Demonstrate punctuality, a willingness to learn, and a positive attitude in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business decisions. In this role, you will take full ownership of our business intelligence platforms, develop robust analytical models, and collaborate closely with stakeholders across departments. Your work will enable the creation of impactful dashboards and reports that support strategic growth initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop advanced, interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Apache Superset, or Metabase.
- Write optimized SQL queries and build modular data transformations using dbt.
- Conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
- Collaborate with business units to define key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and reporting requirements.
- Present data insights clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ensure data integrity by validating, cleaning, and maintaining reporting systems.
- Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics and data visualization.
- Work alongside data engineering teams to design scalable data pipelines and workflows.
- Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues across ingestion tools such as Airbyte and DLT Hub.
- Support deployment processes, including testing and validating data models in staging and production environments.

Required Qualifications:
- 4 to 6 years of experience as a data analyst or BI developer.
- Proficiency with at least two major BI platforms, including Power BI, Tableau, Superset, or Metabase.
- Advanced SQL skills with a proven track record of writing and optimizing complex queries.
- Experience working with dbt and dimensional data modeling techniques.
- Familiarity with data extraction and ELT tools such as Airbyte, DLT Hub, or Fivetran.
- Understanding of deployment workflows and the ability to identify and resolve data issues across different environments.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders and tell compelling data-driven stories.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities and the capability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
- Experience mentoring analysts or leading small analytics teams is highly desirable.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where your analytical expertise will directly influence business outcomes. If you are passionate about turning data into strategic insights and enjoy collaborating across teams, this position is an excellent fit.

title: Data Analyst
description_html:
Sundial Home is seeking a diligent Data Analyst with at least one year of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate excels at interpreting data to uncover trends and support strategic decisions. This role requires expertise in data visualization, statistical analysis, and business intelligence tools to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. The Data Analyst must possess excellent communication skills and the ability to present findings effectively to stakeholders. The position does not involve team management but requires strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly across departments. The Data Analyst will use advanced Excel functions such as Pivot Tables and Power Query to process and analyze data. The role demands a professional attitude, strong organizational abilities, and a commitment to delivering precise and timely reports.   • Utilize Excel, including Pivot Tables and Power Query, to process and analyze large datasets efficiently.
  • Leverage business intelligence tools to create automated reporting solutions that support decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights aligned with business objectives.
  • Prepare clear and concise documentation of analysis processes, methodologies, and findings to facilitate knowledge sharing.
  • Present analytical results and recommendations to stakeholders using strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Manage time effectively to meet project deadlines while maintaining high-quality data analysis standards.
  • Maintain data security and confidentiality according to organizational policies.

title: Principal Data Business Analyst - Customer 360 & Graph Intelligence

title: Senior Data Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst who will play a critical role in transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business decisions. This position involves taking full ownership of our business intelligence platforms, developing robust analytical models, and collaborating closely with various stakeholders to deliver impactful dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to effectively translate data findings into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop advanced, interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Apache Superset, or Metabase.
- Write optimized SQL queries and build modular data transformations using dbt to ensure efficient data processing.
- Conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
- Collaborate with business units to define key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and reporting requirements.
- Present insights clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Maintain data integrity by validating, cleaning, and monitoring reporting systems.
- Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics and data visualization.
- Work closely with data engineering teams to design scalable data pipelines and workflows.
- Troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues across ingestion tools such as Airbyte, DLT Hub, and others.
- Support deployment processes, including testing and validating data models in staging and production environments.

Required Qualifications:
- 4 to 6 years of experience as a data analyst or BI developer.
- Proficiency in at least two major BI platforms, including Power BI, Tableau, Superset, or Metabase.
- Advanced SQL skills with a proven track record of writing and optimizing complex queries.
- Hands-on experience with dbt and dimensional data modeling techniques.
- Familiarity with data extraction and ELT tools such as Airbyte, DLT Hub, or Fivetran.
- Understanding of deployment workflows and the ability to identify and resolve data issues across different environments.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to manage stakeholders and tell compelling data stories.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities and the capability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
- Experience mentoring analysts or leading small analytics teams is highly desirable.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where your analytical expertise will directly contribute to business growth. You will be part of a collaborative team focused on innovation and continuous improvement in data practices. If you are passionate about data and enjoy working at the intersection of technology and business, this position is an excellent fit.

description_html:
Edge Chartered Certified Accountants, Mortgages & Legal Advisers is a well-established firm based in the West Midlands, specializing in property accountancy, taxation, business advisory, and support services for small and medium-sized businesses. title: Workforce Analyst
description_html:
US Mobile is pioneering the future of wireless communication with a vision of a unified network accessible to anyone, anywhere, on any device. Our approach is customer-empowered, fast-moving, and challenges traditional methods. Our teams are agile, cross-functional, and take full ownership of their work. We are seeking a Workforce Analyst based in Lahore to address a critical question: how much human capacity is needed, where it should be allocated, what it costs, and what value it delivers.

This role goes beyond traditional workforce management. With hundreds of Product Experts supporting customers daily, their time represents one of our largest investments. Instead of simply maintaining this investment, you will design the models and systems that clarify capacity decisions. You will explore unanswered questions such as forecasting demand for new launches, understanding the true value of handle time, and determining where human effort should be focused as AI takes on more tasks.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the demand forecasting process by modeling how customer contact fluctuates with growth, launches, promotions, and seasonal trends, providing leadership with proactive insights.
- Translate demand forecasts into capacity strategies, defining the number of people needed, required skills, channel allocation, costs, and service levels.
- Develop the people-side model by analyzing hiring, ramp-up, tenure, performance, and attrition to identify levers that accelerate new hire productivity and improve retention.
- Collaborate with developers and AI teams to embed forecasts, rules, and signals into our in-house workforce platform, turning analysis into actionable systems.
- Uncover hidden insights in data, such as unseen demand, wasted capacity, or misleading metrics.
- Experiment with new operating models, channel mixes, and staffing strategies while working closely with Operations, People, and Product Experience teams in Pakistan and the US, representing the workforce perspective in key operational decisions.

Required Qualifications

- 1 to 3 years of experience in operations analytics, strategy, consulting, or a data-driven role where your analysis influenced real business decisions.
- Strong skills in forecasting and statistics, including understanding trends, seasonality, and uncertainty, with the ability to critically assess data quality.
- Genuine curiosity about people as well as numbers, with an interest in what drives employee retention, growth, and performance.
- Excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
- A builder’s mindset, preferring to automate repetitive reports rather than manually update them.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership from initial inquiry through to final decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

US Mobile offers a market-competitive salary along with flexible working hours to support work-life balance. You will join a fast-growing, high-impact environment with a vibrant startup culture. Additional benefits include meal and transport allowances and comprehensive health coverage.

You will thrive in this role if you approach dashboards with the question, “What isn’t this telling me?” and prefer building models that make decisions obvious rather than making repetitive manual decisions. If you find people as fascinating as data—curious about why they stay, leave, and excel—and if you are proactive in using data to challenge the status quo, this role is an excellent fit.

We value systems thinking and data fluency over traditional career paths. If you are ready to turn data into actionable decisions and shape the future of workforce planning at US Mobile, we encourage you to apply.

title: Data & BI Analyst
description_html:
Millsdale is seeking a skilled Data & Business Intelligence Analyst to join its analytics team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights by leveraging robust data visualization and business intelligence tools. The ideal candidate brings at least three years of hands-on experience with SQL and Power BI, capable of developing comprehensive reports, dashboards, and data models. The role demands strong analytical and problem-solving skills to interpret data accurately and translate technical findings into clear, understandable information for stakeholders. Although prior experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or familiarity with DevOps and observability practices is advantageous, it is not mandatory. The successful analyst thrives in a self-directed environment, tackling ambiguous challenges and providing well-reasoned recommendations to support business decisions. In this position, the Data & BI Analyst is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data reporting solutions that enhance the decision-making process at Millsdale. The analyst works closely with various departments to understand their data needs and deliver tailored insights through effective dashboards and visual reports. This role requires expertise in SQL querying, ETL processes, Power Query transformations, and DAX calculations to streamline data access and improve accuracy. Strong communication skills are essential to explain technical concepts in a straightforward manner, ensuring data-driven initiatives align with the companys strategic goals. While this position does not involve team management, the analyst will collaborate across functions to influence data strategy and promote best practices in business intelligence.
Responsibilities
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to present business insights clearly.
  • Write complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis to support various business functions.
  • Design and implement data models ensuring data integrity and efficiency for reporting and analytics.
  • Execute ETL processes to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
  • Use Power Query and DAX to perform data transformation and complex calculations within Power BI.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies that support business decision-making.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into effective BI solutions.
  • Communicate complex technical information and analysis results in an easily understandable manner.
  • Investigate ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and provide clear justifications for recommendations.
  • Support ongoing improvement of BI tools and data processes to enhance reporting capabilities.
  • Maintain documentation related to data models, ETL workflows, and business intelligence procedures.
  • Stay updated with emerging BI trends and technologies and evaluate their applicability to Millsdales needs.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description_html:
Wise is a global technology company dedicated to creating the best way to move and manage money worldwide. Our mission is to make international money transfers and payments easier, faster, and more affordable for people and businesses everywhere. As part of our team in Hyderabad, you will contribute to building a new, scalable network that supports seamless cross-border financial transactions while minimizing risks related to financial crime.

Key Responsibilities

- Balance Risk, Friction, and Cost in KYC Analytics: You will work on complex challenges involving risk-based decisions, ensuring the right balance between preventing onboarding of criminals and maintaining smooth customer experiences with operational efficiency. This includes sizing opportunities, modeling impacts on volume, cost, and risk, and evaluating control changes and operational experiments. You will also analyze document rejection reasons and the effectiveness of recovery prompts.

- Design Scalable Platforms: Collaborate with your team to build sustainable, long-term systems that support multi-region operations. This role focuses on creating robust foundations rather than short-term growth hacks.

- Adopt a Data-as-a-Product Mindset: Partner with engineers to develop well-instrumented systems that provide end-to-end visibility into performance. You will define and maintain authoritative datasets and dashboards covering onboarding funnels, manual reviews, document processing, and operational metrics. Additionally, you will create self-serve data assets and documentation to empower stakeholders to independently answer common questions.

- Stakeholder Partnership: Translate complex questions from Customer Due Diligence (CDD) Operations, Product, and Engineering teams into clear analytical plans. Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations effectively to influence product outcomes and operational improvements.

This position is a Senior Analyst role embedded within a cross-functional product team, working closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance to enhance control effectiveness and customer experience.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in data analytics or a related field, preferably within financial services or technology sectors.
- Strong understanding of Know Your Customer (KYC) processes, risk management, and financial crime prevention.
- Ability to model and quantify risk, cost, and operational impacts.
- Experience designing scalable data platforms and dashboards.
- Excellent communication skills to translate complex data insights into actionable recommendations.
- Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Wise values diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering an environment where all employees feel respected and empowered to contribute. We offer a truly international and inclusive workplace that supports career growth and personal development.

Our benefits include flexible work arrangements, sabbaticals, stock options, and unique mission-driven days such as “me days” and “mission days.” We are committed to building a culture where everyone can thrive and help us build money without borders.

Join us to be part of a team that is shaping the future of global finance with innovation, integrity, and inclusivity. For more information about working at Wise and our team culture, visit our careers page and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
